scope: Minimal selected runner/OpenSSL-wrapper ownership/evidence correction. No product DNS/TLS behavior, tests/timeouts/gates or speculative KOL09 correction; no execution grant.

requirements.requirement: Treat wrapper group/session as a separate owned resource.
requirements.acceptance: Identify actual wrapper PID/PGID before native spawn. Validate ownership against private run/phase/invocation channel and selected wrapper. Use exact identities only; no global inventory or unrelated-group signaling.

requirements.requirement: Registration publication precedes outer retention, which precedes ACK, which precedes native Popen.
requirements.acceptance: No matching ACK means no native launch. Outer retains exact group in cleanup set and a durable run-local custody record before ACK delivery. Missing/malformed/duplicate/cross-run/phase identities or ACKs fail closed. Retention survives ACK delivery or later validation failure.

Specify wrapper entry/bootstrap, publication, bounded ACK wait and native-launch/start-receipt order. Imports/config/channel/publication failure cannot create native work. Pre-ACK timeout, broken channel, root cancellation and bootstrap error have bounded exit paths. State how outer drains/rejects late registration and records uncertainty. Missing registration never means native authorization; do not claim unknown bootstrap process cleanup without evidence.

requirements.requirement: Use durable identity and a private finite channel.
requirements.acceptance: Bind registration/ACK/native/completion to fresh run ID, phase/invocation identity, wrapper PID/PGID, selected executable/argv and deadlines. Bound message sizes/counts and handle partial/truncated messages/writes. Keep authoritative custody evidence outside disposable scratch. Never discard a known group because later evidence is invalid.

requirements.requirement: Retain exact native child promptly and bound its whole lifecycle.
requirements.acceptance: After ACK only, Popen stays in acknowledged wrapper group. Retain child before further fallible work. Normal/error/signal/output-cap/deadline paths close streams and terminate/wait/reap that child, retain result/timing and never detach. Reads/waits are deadline-aware; output remains bounded. Outer acknowledged-group cleanup covers wrapper failure.

requirements.requirement: Cleanup all known groups before deleting scratch/keys.
requirements.acceptance: Outer finally covers both VM children and every retained wrapper group, including missing completion, failed ACK delivery and interruption. Exact group absence and direct-child reaping where applicable precede scratch deletion. Preserve scratch and failed cleanup evidence on uncertainty, and retain earlier cleanup errors after recovery. No replay or process sweep.

requirements.requirement: Keep original finite host budget; fail closed on protocol failure.
requirements.acceptance: Registration/ACK/native/output work remains within40second work/46second cleanup/52second observation/55second receipt envelope, with remaining-budget checks and no automatic retry. No proof of progress under arbitrary kernel/filesystem/interpreter stalls is required; actual receipt retains elapsed/failure boundaries.

requirements.requirement: Extend exact schemas/acceptance for actual ownership topology.
requirements.acceptance: Record registration, retained custody, ACK outcome, native start/completion and each group cleanup, including incomplete failure states. Validate actual member sets, nested types/identity pairing, exact selected tool/argv/count and hashes. Do not compare native group to VMpid or turn eventual cleanup into clean resource acceptance. Retain available evidence when another artifact is absent.

requirements.requirement: Define focused future controls without executing them now.
requirements.acceptance: Separately released controls cover missing/malformed/stale ACK with zero native launches; outer interruption after retention/before ACK; wrapper failure after ACK/before native; failure just after Popen/before start receipt; output cap/native deadline; missing completion; late/partial registration during cancellation; known-group cleanup and scratch preservation on uncertainty. Use a minimal controlled child where sufficient; actual OpenSSL/TLS needs a separate exact release.

Keep failed candidate2, prior reviews, formatter packet and root later cleanup sample immutable. Charlist syntax correction does not fix custody. No GA, product app/provider, UI/native/device, production publication, customer message, credential or store/workflow change follows.

not_required: Global process inventory or process sweep
Speculative product fix or test/timeout weakening
Any new compiler/OpenSSL/TLS/native runtime to prepare/review this contract
